purpose: Audit a parameter-free coherent-monopole completion that boosts only the shell-shared Newtonian radial field, retains measured Newtonian multipoles, and adds the projected routing correction with zero boundary difference.

equation.center: x_c=integral rho_b x dV / integral rho_b dV
equation.shell_coordinate: n=round(|x-x_c|/h) on the native Cartesian grid
equation.physical_interpretation: the shell-shared monopole is coherently enhanced; measured Newtonian multipoles are retained without the enhancement
equation.spherical_limit: Phi_coh has radial acceleration g_M0 up to native-grid shell discretization
equation.high_acceleration_limit: g_M0-g_N0 tends to zero, so Phi_coh tends to Phi_N with its multipoles

numerics.shell_definition: nearest integer native-grid radius; no smoothing width or fitted bin scale
numerics.rotation_test: swap x and y axes of the ellipsoid and compare correspondingly transposed fields

selection_rule: Advance the exact coherent-monopole operator to a separately frozen spent joint screen only if every spherical-limit, correction-isotropy, curl, rotation, identity, high-acceleration, boundary, finite, accounting, no-observation, and sealed-target gate passes. No shell smoothing, scale, exponent, multiplier, or fitted physical quantity may be added after this audit.
claim_boundary: P0696 is a numerical and mathematical audit, not an observational test.
Shell averaging about one global baryonic centroid is nonlocal and not yet derived from a covariant action or causal evolution equation.
Retaining Newtonian multipoles while boosting only the monopole is a new phenomenological hypothesis.
